\section{Purpose and normative use}
\label{sec:eng-purpose}

This specification turns the shared SCI-JINC scientific authority into a
future conformance-review surface.  It does not introduce independent science.
If prose in this engineering introduction appears broader than the shared
definitions, equations, assumptions, requirements, or predictions, the shared
module controls and the broader engineering reading is invalid.

The conformance object is one claimed realization of the SCI-JINC observation
estimator under one exact contract version, parameter-set identity,
coefficient-family identity, target WCS, array, observation, and lifecycle
generation.  A future assessment must bind that object before drawing any
conclusion.  This author draft binds no implementation, schema, interface,
file, function, algorithm, or execution.

Conformance is evaluated requirement by requirement.  Each result is exactly
one of \emph{pass}, \emph{fail}, \emph{not assessed}, or \emph{not
applicable under a contract-authorized condition}.  Missing evidence is
\emph{not assessed}, never pass.  A pass at one layer does not promote a claim
at another layer.

\section{Applicability and fail-closed preconditions}
\label{sec:eng-applicability}

A numerical conformance route exists only when all scientific identities and
inputs required by the shared core are available.  In particular:

\begin{enumerate}
\item the exact transformed signal occurrence and exact same-processed-sample
AST coordinate association are available;
\item one exact PTC coefficient family/version explicitly permits SCI-JINC,
is selected under the authorized lifecycle, and supplies compatible realized
payload and QC;
\item one exact scientifically authorized TolTEC array-associated kernel
parameter set is resolved; and
\item target WCS, pixel size, effective \texttt{subpixel\_n}, processed-sample
frequency, observation, array, plan, destination, and lifecycle identities are
complete and mutually compatible.
\end{enumerate}

Absence of a coefficient route or TolTEC parameter set is a typed unavailable
state.  It cannot be converted into an executable route by unity, a MAP family,
an alternate family, an inherited 45~m denominator, inherited shape values,
mode-dependent $r_{\max}$, or any other hidden implementation default.  A
future assessment may test fail-closed behavior without claiming a scientifically
authorized numerical production route.

\section{Future conformance procedure}
\label{sec:eng-procedure}

A later authorized assessor should proceed in the following order:

\begin{enumerate}
\item \textbf{Bind identity.} Record the exact SCI-JINC contract, candidate,
observation, stable array, plan/realization, target WCS, coefficient family,
parameter set, destination, and lifecycle generation.
\item \textbf{Check source availability.} Confirm that every producer-owned
fact is present under the exact boundary and that no excluded fallback or
ordinary MAP inheritance is used.
\item \textbf{Check algebra and membership.} Establish the exact occurrence
population, AST association, center-domain decision, square membership,
point-phase coefficient, and coupled accumulator equations.
\item \textbf{Check units and limits.} Exercise the zero limit, signed lobes,
coefficient classes, scaling predictions, cancellation states, and
coefficient-squared-time unit.
\item \textbf{Check grouping and publication.} Exercise array cardinality,
destination uniqueness, same-observation chunking, bundle atomicity, and
absence of unauthorized roles or coaddition.
\item \textbf{Disclose numerical policy.} State the function-evaluation,
phase/cache, accumulation/reduction, and comparison policies and demonstrate
combined error negligible relative to the approximately $10^{-3}$ scale.
\item \textbf{Run every prediction.} Record construction, expected result,
observed result, tolerance rationale, and pass/fail/not-assessed state for each
stable prediction identifier.
\item \textbf{Separate conclusions.} Report algebraic conformance separately
from representation fidelity, numerical and observational validation, achieved
performance, readiness, and production authorization.
\end{enumerate}

This sequence is not an implementation architecture.  It is an evidence
ordering intended to prevent a successful compile, one numerical example, or
one stored product from being mistaken for complete scientific conformance.

\section{Required output-role interpretation}
\label{sec:eng-output-view}

The fixed schema is closed.  $N_p$, $C_p$, and $Q_p$ are distinct primary
accumulators.  $m_p$ is derived only on accepted local support.
$T_p^{(\kappa^2)}$ is method-specific temporal accounting.  No role may be
renamed or reinterpreted so that $Q_p$ becomes precision, $C_p$ becomes
exposure, coefficient-squared time becomes acquired time, or local map support
becomes a standalone availability product.

Whole-bundle and local-pixel outcomes must remain separate.  A required
whole-role formation or publication failure suppresses the bundle.  A local
zero, cancellation, or inadequate-support state remains content in a complete
map role.  A completion marker cannot override a missing required role.

\section{Claim discipline}
\label{sec:eng-claims}

The following conclusions require separate evidence and separate authority:

\begin{longtable}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.28\textwidth}
                        >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.62\textwidth}@{}}
\toprule
Claim & Required basis \\
\midrule
\endhead
Algebraic scientific conformance & Complete requirement and prediction
assessment under the exact contract identity. \\
Representation fidelity & Evidence that persisted or transmitted identities,
units, states, and roles preserve the conformant scientific objects. \\
Numerical validation & Authorized profiles establishing realized error and
conditioning adequacy; contract text alone is insufficient. \\
Response/covariance fidelity & Separately authorized products and validation;
base v0.1 supplies neither. \\
Observational performance & Named observational evidence and acceptance
authority. \\
Readiness and production & Explicit operational qualification and owner
authorization. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

At document revision \DocumentRevision{}, every layer beyond draft algebraic
specification remains not assessed or not performed.
